caption: The query keeps all three rows (88, 72 and 95 are above 60) and sorts them highest first, so the cursor hands back Meera 95, then Asha 88, then Ravi 72. The fourth moveToNext() returns false and getCount() is 3.

spec.title: query() on students with marks > 60, ORDER BY marks DESC
spec.aria: A downward flow: query() filters the students table with marks > 60 and sorts by marks descending, returning a cursor; moveToNext() then reads three rows in order — Meera 95 with _id 3, Asha 88 with _id 1, Ravi 72 with _id 2 — and a fourth call returns false, with getCount() equal to 3.
